annotation.title_clean: Stratégie continentale sur l'intelligence artificielle : Mettre l'IA au service du développement et de la prospérité de l'Afrique
annotation.title_en: Continental Artificial Intelligence Strategy: Harnessing AI for Africa's Development and Prosperity
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Commission de l'Union africaine (African Union Commission)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: African Union continental AI strategy adopted July 2024 by the AU Executive Council. It sets five focus areas and fifteen policy actions: maximising AI benefits, minimising risks, building capacity, cooperation and investment. It promotes multi-level, flexible, risk-based governance, ethics, regulatory sandboxes and national strategies. Physical or robotic AI is barely addressed.
key_provisions_or_claims: Five focus areas and fifteen policy actions, with objectives to 2030, aligned with Agenda 2063 and the SDGs
Promotes flexible, forward-looking, risk-based regulation and multi-level AI governance
Proposes national and regional AI governance bodies, an independent regional AI ethics committee and an advisory committee
Recommends regulatory sandboxes, AI transparency registers, impact assessments and public procurement standards for AI
Calls on member states to develop national AI strategies and build skills, data and infrastructure
